title: Ridgeline Installation Services — Job Site Requirements by Program
content:
Ridgeline Installation Services books an in-home measure for a program only when the job site meets that program's entry requirements: the type of home and the size of the project. The requirements are judged on the site as the customer states it when the measure is booked.

## Requirements table

| Program | Site types accepted | Project size requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | single-family home, townhome, condo | at least 100 square feet of project area |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | single-family home, townhome, condo | at least 100 square feet of project area |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | single-family home, townhome | at least 1 opening |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | single-family home, townhome, condo | at least 10 linear feet of cabinets |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | single-family home, townhome, condo | at least 1 bathroom |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | single-family home, townhome | no more than 3 stories |

## Points of judgement

- Both parts must be met: a site type the program accepts, and the program's size requirement.
- A condo is accepted by the carpet, hard surface flooring, kitchen cabinet and countertop, and bath remodel programs; the window and door program and the roofing and siding program accept single-family homes and townhomes only.
- A minimum is met at the figure itself: 100 square feet meets the 100 square foot minimum, 99 square feet does not; 10 linear feet of cabinets meets the kitchen minimum.
- The roofing and siding limit is a maximum: a home of 3 stories meets it, a home of 4 stories does not.

## Hypothetical cases

| Stated site (hypothetical) | Program | Requirements met |
|---|---|---|
| Condo, 240 square feet of flooring | Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | yes |
| Condo, 6 replacement windows | Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | no (site type) |
| Townhome, 85 square feet of carpet | Ridgeline Carpet Installation | no (size) |
| Single-family home, 2 stories | Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | yes |
